refit_bvh: refit the bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) for MuJoCo MJX warp model and data given a render context
refit_bvh_jax_impl: run the JAX implementation of BVH refit on MuJoCo model and data with a render context pytree
refit_bvh_vmap: apply vectorized mapping to refit_bvh for batched MuJoCo model and data inputs
refit_bvh_shim: bridge MuJoCo warp model and data structs to call the underlying mjwarp.refit_bvh kernel
refit_bvh: test the BVH refit function with MuJoCo model, data, and render context arguments
